abilities.name: run-away
abilities.effect: Ensures success fleeing from wild battles.

abilities.name: guts
abilities.effect: Increases Attack to 1.5× with a major status ailment.

abilities.name: hustle
abilities.effect: Strengthens physical moves to inflict 1.5× damage, but decreases their accuracy to 0.8×.

kanto.flavorText: Bites anything when it attacks. Small and very quick, it is a common sight in many places.

original-johto.flavorText: This POKéMON's impressive vital­ ity allows it to live anywhere. It also multiplies very quickly.

hoenn.flavorText: A RATTATA is cautious in the extreme. Even while it is asleep, it constantly moves its ears and listens for danger. It will make its nest anywhere.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: Cautious in the extreme, its hardy vitality lets it live in any kind of environment.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: Cautious in the extreme, its hardy vitality lets it live in any kind of environment.

updated-johto.flavorText: Living wherever there is food available, it ceaselessly scavenges for edibles the entire day.

original-unova.flavorText: Cautious in the extreme, its hardy vitality lets it live in any kind of environment.

updated-unova.flavorText: It searches for food all day. It gnaws on hard objects to wear down its fangs, which grow constantly during its lifetime.

kalos.flavorText: Its fangs are long and very sharp. They grow continuously, so it gnaws on hard things to whittle them down.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Rattata is cautious in the extreme. Even while it is asleep, it constantly listens by moving its ears around. It is not picky about where it lives—it will make its nest anywhere.

original-alola.flavorText: With their strong capacity for survival, they can live in dirty places without concern. Left unchecked, their numbers multiply rapidly.

updated-alola.flavorText: This Pokémon is common but hazardous. Its sharp incisors can easily cut right through hard wood.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: Will chew on anything with its fangs. If you see one, you can be certain that 40 more live in the area.
